doc.title: Skills — Noa Tournoy
doc.desc: Languages, front end, data and BI, infrastructure, Google Looker and LookML certifications, spoken languages. Every line points to a piece of work where it was used.
lede: A list is only worth something if every line has been used somewhere. The ones below point to the work where they were.
v1: Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, SQL, C, C++, Java, PHP, LookML
v2: React, Next.js, HTML, CSS, Three.js and GLSL, React Native / Expo, Node.js, Electron
v3: Looker, LookML, BigQuery, Google Cloud Platform, PostgreSQL, complex SQL queries
v4: Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, GitHub Actions, Vercel, continuous integration and delivery
v5: Git and GitHub, PostgreSQL, Auth0, Godot, Visual Studio Code, Cisco Packet Tracer, Notion, Trello
v6: Google Looker · LookML, during the 2025 ADEO internship · AWS Academy Cloud Foundations · CCNA Introduction to Networks
ou1: Looker, LookML, BigQuery, Terraform, Kubernetes: DataSentinel, the security monitoring dashboard at ADEO.
ou2: TypeScript, React, Three.js, GLSL, WebAudio: Éclosion, a fully procedural 3D web experience.
ou3: C++20, Godot, binary protocol: SupKonQuest, multiplayer real-time strategy.
ou4: C++17 with no dependencies: laying_grass, down to the hand-written JSON parser.
ou5: Python, Pygame, sockets: Ludoria, three networked board games.
ou6: React, TypeScript, Cypress: Gamedex, a game catalogue on the RAWG API.
v8: Measure before fixing. Verify every visual change with a capture. Isolate before accusing. Encode each lesson paid for as a test or an invariant, so it only costs once.
